svg.title: Real and Carnot engines
svg.desc: (a) A real engine between the same reservoirs converts less of Q_h to work, and gives more to the cold reservoir, than a Carnot engine would; the dashed outline shows the Carnot engine’s larger work output. (b) Friction in the output mechanism turns part of the work, W_f, into heat Q_f that also goes to the cold reservoir.
